Source-only correction pinned for fresh parent review.

- Returned canonical account ID plus random ownership marker are checkpointed before token use. Reruns inspect exactly that ID, correlate the authenticated profile marker, preserve stable credentials and recover canonical renamed/lost usernames. Uncertain/legacy/pending provenance is Manual, never name-only adoption or another account/token.
- Password rejection, disabled status, MFA and policy drift are targeted Manual; actual infrastructure/malformed responses remain failures. Official 3.2.1 Edit user controls permit a person to restore the same saved password/Active status, with stable-token reuse afterward. Missing provenance/credentials have no automatic replacement/ingestion route; verified Backup or separately approved migration is required. Admin credentials and all existing account permissions/tokens are preserved.
- Direct controls remain inside existing fixture bodies; no new test functions/cases/comments/dependencies. Focused tests, formatting, build, both vet runs, full Go tests, TUI/Activity/Paperless race checks, Bash syntax and diff gates passed.
- No runtime, protected-file access, registry/shared verifier edits, children or merge. Historical `368cc026` prerequisite evidence is not current native/rendered/lifecycle acceptance. Draft, fresh parent reviews, normalization/registration and new bounded proof remain held.

Coverage cleanup pinned for fresh final Standards/Spec review; this supersedes earlier final-tree case/coverage claims.

No unknown/person-authored code or replacement cases were touched.
- Full fixed-base inventory confirms only required API response adapters remain; the secret store/helper and all baseline test bodies/assertions are byte-identical. Retained coverage is Setup/Check success, all-step rerun skipping and administrator-denial hint. No separate least-permission, identity/token-count or negative recovery assertions remain.
- Ownership, rename/lost-ID, denial/MFA/disabled, partial-write and malformed-response guards now have source/schema/compile-only coverage. Production token/App/descriptor/common code is unchanged from `2b975344`; historical `368cc026` runtime is not current acceptance.
- Reduced-tree focused/full tests and TUI/Activity/Paperless race checks passed uncached, plus formatting/build/both vets/Bash/diff gates. Draft/native/render/lifecycle holds remain; no runtime, children or merge.

Both fresh final stage-1 SOURCE reviews pass with zero findings at df16f7231e9299e9fb6c5975da6669f398f6ce30 against fixed actual 5aafb4c1833fd4cd9caf0f7beaac31e625aafe22. Canonical owned-ID/marker/profile correlation preserves the selected account across renamed/lost usernames; uncertain provenance stays Manual without adoption or replacement. Official same-account recovery is retryable and does not automatically reset passwords, reactivate users, disable MFA or rewrite permissions. The owner removed only its unrequested new scenarios/fault machinery; independent byte comparisons confirm complete baseline test bodies/assertions, helper and secret store are identical to the base, with required response adapters only. Non-baseline guards have source/schema/compile-only coverage, and historical runtime evidence is not current acceptance. Reported final full gate passed; reviewers did not rerun it. Keep draft: final verifier/normalization/registration, native/Stats rendering, both orders, recovery and shared lifecycle acceptance remain outstanding; #289 stays open.
